author: KEXP
description: Ishamael Butler returns to KEXP with the latest Shabazz Palaces record 'It's a Style Sport.' Soaring through experimental, electronic, Afrofuturistic, and alt-hip-hop terrain, the Seattle artist shares a performance of "Tongue In Chic" and more.
title: Shabazz Palaces performs "Tongue In Chic" & more Live on KEXP
